program: APPUI-01 Phase 2 - Stage and Live Production Experience

scope.claim: All presently authorized static-safe Stage/live-production presentation requirements have direct bounded evidence or inherited frozen architecture support sufficient to treat the static framework as stable for bounded Phase-3 visual-language integration.
scope.does_not_claim: Phase 2 is fully complete, runtime semantics are finalized, transcript-dependent motion is unblocked, or Product-gated controls are resolved.

coverage_matrix.requirement: creator focus/selection distinct from Director opportunity and performance state
current performed moment without transcript dominance
listening, performed silence and system non-response remain distinct
material relationship salience distinct from selection/opportunity/obligation
nonverbal action and refusal remain Character-legible without dialogue-bubble dependence
creator inspection remains UI rather than fictional agency
coverage_matrix.evidence: selected-state inspection plus frozen Phase-1 inspector grammar

coverage_matrix.requirement: responsive Stage framing and 2-5 design-stress capacity

held_or_unresolved.reason: real E0-A versus E0-E behavioral evidence remains unavailable
creator intervention taxonomy and effects are not promoted Product law
acceptance and consequence semantics remain unresolved
runtime behavior is not yet authoritative
infrastructure/provider and Performer mechanics remain outside frozen Stage presentation law

engineering_reconciliation.checkpoint: E0-D active; P01 Slot 1 authorized with protected rebind/window/capacity gates pending; provider traffic zero
engineering_reconciliation.effect_on_design: Engineering progress does not invalidate the frozen shell/static Stage envelope and does not unlock transcript-dependent Stage motion or Product-gated controls.

open: material/surface language inside the proven shell and Stage hierarchy
identity accents that do not alter Product semantics or Character identity
static hierarchy/refinement of typography, dividers, borders, depth, trace and contextual surfaces
static icon-family exploration only where control meaning is already frozen
Light/Dark parity while preserving the invariant dark Stage
held: micro-interactions that encode unresolved runtime state

next: Begin one bounded Phase-3 static visual-language integration study on accepted APPUI structure while preserving all Phase-1/2 semantic separations and blocked dynamic/Product-gated areas.
